name: Umm Al Qura for Development and Construction Company
summary: Umm Al Qura for Development and Construction Company engages in real estate activities in Saudi Arabia. The company owns and develops the MASAR destination, an urban project in Makkah. It is also involved in the purchasing, selling, and dividing of lands and real estate; off-plan sales activities; and management and leasing of owned or leased non-residential properties. In addition, the company constructs residential and non-residential buildings, including schools, hospitals, and hotels; and roads, streets, sidewalks, road supplies, bridges, and tunnels. Umm Al Qura for Development and Construction Company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Mecca, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
